title: s500-literature-201: Whole-night hippocampal depth and scalp Cz sleep EEG with spindle and ripple detections, 14 epilepsy patients (Ngo, Fell & Staresina, 2020) (derivative)
description: Whole-night sleep recordings from 14 pre-surgical epilepsy patients, comprising a posterior hippocampal depth channel and scalp Cz EEG sampled at 1 kHz (135.6 h in total). The derivative dataset repackages the authors' released data into BIDS and includes sleep stage scoring, artifact intervals, and automated ripple and spindle detections. It supports investigation of hippocampal-neocortical coupling between sleep spindles and long-duration ripples during sleep.
methods_description: Two channels per patient (hippocampal depth contact of the non-pathological hemisphere with the highest spindle density, and scalp Cz) were recorded overnight at 1 kHz, referenced to linked mastoids with a hardware band-pass of 0.01-300 Hz. Sleep was scored following Rechtschaffen & Kales criteria, and ripples, spindles and artifacts were identified with the authors' automated detectors. Released FieldTrip structures were converted to BrainVision float32 format.
